text: 'I wasn't just investigating this place. I was sent here.'
'There was something I had to find... something inside this cabin.'
IT SEEMS YOUR MEMORY IS STARTING TO RECOVER.
'I don't quite remember what it was, though.'
THAT'S QUITE ALRIGHT. YOU'LL HAVE PLENTY OF TIME TO REMEMBER.
NOW, LET'S MOVE ON TO SOMETHING MORE INTERESTING.
FROM THIS POINT FORWARD YOU WILL POSSESS SPECIAL ABILITIES.
PRESS AND HOLD THE Z KEY TO ACTIVATE IT.
YOUR CURRENT ABILITY ALLOWS YOU TO SLOW DOWN TIME WHILE IT IS ACTIVE.
USE IT TO YOUR ADVANTAGE. SOME OBSTACLES MAY BE DIFFICULT TO OVERCOME AT NORMAL SPEED.
KEEP IN MIND THAT YOUR ABILITY HAS A COOLDOWN AND A MAX USE TIME INDICATED BY THE SMALL SQUARE ABOVE THE PLAYER.
THAT'S ALL. LET'S SEE HOW WELL YOU CAN HANDLE THIS ONE.
